title: Drive the honua CLI for a feature count
prompt: Write a standalone TypeScript ESM program that shells out to the honua CLI to count features. The CLI entry script's absolute path is in the HONUA_EVAL_CLI environment variable and must be run with the current Node executable (process.execPath). Spawn it (node:child_process) with the arguments: query EvalIncidents/0 --count --json --base-url <HONUA_EVAL_BASE_URL>. The CLI prints a JSON object that includes a count property. Parse the CLI's stdout and print exactly one line to your own stdout: {"count": <the parsed count>}.

context.notes: Golden workflow: the honua CLI wraps the SDK; --count --json emits a machine-readable envelope.
